description: Draggable component palette for the wireframe editor. Displays all registered WireframeComponentDef entries grouped by category (a 3-column grid of tiles) with a search filter. A tile shows the component's TmIcon (WireframeComponentDef.Icon) and name; the mini stencil SVG preview is the fallback when the icon is missing or not drawable. Items are draggable onto TmWireframeDesignerCanvas via HTML drag-and-drop (data-component-type attribute). Custom components registered via IWireframeComponentProvider appear in a separate 'Custom' tab. Typically used as a child of TmWireframeEditor rather than directly.

parameters.name: OnComponentActivated
parameters.description: Raised when the user activates a component by click, tap or keyboard (Enter/Space), exactly once per gesture - the non-drag alternative to HTML5 drag-and-drop. Payload is the component type string (e.g. 'TmButton'); the editor inserts it centred in the visible canvas area.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the toolbox wrapper.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Shows the palette inert: items are aria-disabled, muted (tm-wd-toolbox__item--disabled), not draggable and never raise OnComponentActivated. TmWireframeEditor passes its effective read-only state (host ReadOnly or the user Read-only toggle).

parameters.name: SingleColumn
parameters.description: Presents the palette as a single column of named rows (icon + name, a finger-sized target) instead of the 3-column tile grid. TmWireframeEditor sets it for its tablet overlay drawer; adds the tm-wd-toolbox--single-column modifier.

parameters.name: ComponentScope
parameters.description: Optional application scope used to resolve custom wireframe components.

examples.title: Toolbox inside a custom editor layout
examples.code:
<TmWireframeToolbox OnComponentActivated="OnActivated" />

@code {
    private void OnActivated(string type)
    {
        // Add element to canvas at default position
        Console.WriteLine($"Activated: {type}");
    }
}
